Remark
[$\mathrm U(p,q)/\mathrm{SO}(p,q)$ as a symmetric space]

Source: petersen:page-0406 ↗ rem:pet-ch10-symmetric-space-from-involution 1. ch10:10.5.8Show that $\mathrm U(p,q)/\mathrm{SO}(p,q)$ defines a symmetric space and that $\mathfrak u(p,q)\otimes \mathbb C=\mathfrak {gl}(p+q,\mathbb C)$.
